title: Only One Responsible Source—Sole Source Justification
vector: Competition, Sole Source, J&A, Justification and Approval, Other Than Full and Open
clause_text: This FAR provision authorizes contracting officers to use other than full and open competition when there is only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy the agency's needs. The contracting officer must document that the unique capabilities of a particular source are essential to the requirement, that no other source can perform the work, and that the need is not a result of inadequate advance planning or a lack of competition on previous procurements. A written Justification and Approval (J&A) is required, approved at the level corresponding to the contract value. The J&A must be made publicly available on a Government website within 14 days of contract award. Sole source justifications are subject to agency review and GAO and Court of Federal Claims protest jurisdiction.
